summary: Indian shares look set for a slightly soft open on Friday despite heavy institutional buying, with Asian tech shares firmer but no overnight lead from a holiday-shut Wall Street.

detail.leaders: IT and realty, which led the last two sessions; Asian tech shares are firmer
detail.laggards: Zydus Lifesciences after a US FDA letter; oil-sensitive names while crude stays firm
detail.tone: A forward-looking read for the open, a shade softer than the previous note as GIFT Nifty points lower. Strong buying by both foreign and domestic funds on Thursday is the main cushion.
